method: Independent ordinary URL only; visible mission brief and operator handbook read before play. No source, tests, prior reviews, internals or hidden state read during ordinary attempts. One Chrome Playwright browser, software rendering. Synthetic relative MouseEvent look, normal keyboard/mouse. Live JPEG capture then Escape pause for reasoning; resumed via visible Resume. Screenshots inspected between actions and learned from between attempts. No audio, hardware or enjoyment certification.

attempts.notes: Killed induction guard, reached West Archive. Stood just outside recovery radius (4.1m) and held E, exposed to flank fire. Did not reach finale.

Killed induction and Heart guards, recovered West then East then Heart. Used sprint around east side of induction block and returned to green extraction. Turned to face yard; uplink visibly progressed 0%,33%,74%, then success while strafing left. Last pre-success health 23; no ordinary hidden assistance.

finalStageObservations: Brief tells return via either lit aisle, face yard, move between split baffles and watch flanks. Green extraction marker, distance, dotted route and top progress panel made objective clear.
Induction block interrupted direct return; visible side route resolved it.
Extraction reached with 81 health; exposed center position rapidly lost health to flanks. Uplink progress stayed readable and continued during final strafe.
No finale blocker encountered; successful extraction independently observed.
ratingBasis: Strong cohesive menu typography, weathered industrial mood, readable memory/outcome screens and functional complete mission loop. Combatants are small box-like targets; many through-wall threat labels crowd the screen and make immediate actionable firing targets less clear. Recovery radius required close positioning despite a large visible ring. Brief and handbook are useful. Short vertical slice and synthetic paused controls limit broad quality conclusions; AAA rating reflects limited animation, geometry/detail and encounter depth, not desired score.
